changelog: - fixed a random client crash issue when popping a block.
- added proper light information to the block so the level actually see it as a light source if, it contain a light source.
- added the block as Item now you can silk touch a multiblock, updated the block name and added item tooltip.
- added compatibility with cold and sweat mod, blocks now emit the same temperature they had originally.
- fixed some block support issues, like snow layer or item frames, while it still can be hard sometimes for the block if its shape is complex.
- added even more vanilla block behavior implementation.
